headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4, KPI values, and key data points. Highly geometric and premium.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable sans-serif for dashboard data, tables, and descriptions.

typography.rules: Apply tracking-tight to headings. Never use Inter for headings. Use fluid typography clamp() logic for responsive scaling.

background.description: Very light mint/lime background. Gives a fresh, innovative feel.

surface.description: Main panels are white for legibility. KPI cards and sidebar are deep, luxurious dark green.

layouts.overall: Sidebar navigation on the left, Top fixed header (glassmorphism), and a main scrollable content area. Spacing must be generous (p-6 to p-10).
layouts.sidebar: Fixed width (e.g., 280px), dark deep green background (#022C22), with light mint text for links.
layouts.header: Sticky top, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, containing the 'Frissítés' button with last update timestamp, and global period selectors.
layouts.grid: Bento-style grid for the dashboard overview. 4 columns for KPIs (md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). 2 columns for charts.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle, soft layered shadows. e.g., shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] for light panels. shadow-[0_10px_40px_rgb(16,185,129,0.1)] for active elements.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Large, friendly but enterprise radii. rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for main panels. rounded-xl for internal cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1) on light panels to define edges without heavy shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used on the sticky header and the detail drawer overlay. Must have backdrop-blur-xl and backdrop-saturate-150.

kpi_cards.style: Dark deep green background (#064E3B), bright mint/lime text for the numbers. Subtle hover lift (-translate-y-1) with a soft mint glow shadow.
kpi_cards.content: Title (small, uppercase, tracking-wider), Value (massive Outfit font), Trend indicator (arrow + percentage).

filter_chips.style: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Unselected: white bg, border, dark text. Selected: dark green bg, white text.

charts.style: Use the theme colors. Donut chart for Status. Horizontal bar for Category. Area chart for Monthly trend with gradient fill (mint to transparent). Hide axis lines, use dashed grid lines.
charts.tooltip: Custom Recharts tooltip with rounded corners, dark background, and clear typography.

detail_drawer.style: Sliding panel from the right (w-full max-w-2xl). White background, high elevation shadow. Header with status badge.
detail_drawer.content: Contains Title, Description, Expected Result, Comments, Submitter info, Status, Category, Date, Department, Priority.

refresh_button.interaction: When clicked, show a spinning state and update the 'Utolsó frissítés: [timestamp]' text.

data_table.style: Clean enterprise table. No vertical borders. Generous row padding (py-4). Status pills in rows. Hover effect on rows.

motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slight slide up (y: 20 -> 0) on mount.
motion.list_stagger: Stagger children animations for KPI cards and table rows.
motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must have a transition (duration 200ms ease-out). Buttons scale down slightly on active (tap).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on dark green KPI cards meets WCAG AA standards (use white or very light mint).
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to all filters, buttons, and drawer toggles.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5 for a premium, delicate look.
media.avatars: Use the provided executive portrait URLs for the top submitters list.

avatars.description: Male executive portrait for top submitter
Female executive portrait for top submitter

textures.description: Abstract mint green organic texture, can be used at very low opacity (5%) in the sidebar or header for premium feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: `yarn add @fontsource/outfit @fontsource/manrope` and configure in tailwind.config.js.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for main structural layouts to allow deep customization, but use Recharts for data visualization.
Implement the left sidebar fixed, and right content area scrollable.
For the KPI cards, ensure they use the dark green background (#064E3B) with white/light-mint text, contrasting heavily with the light mint page background (#F0FDF4).
Create dummy data to simulate the Excel data load. Include different statuses, categories, departments, and programs.
Implement the 'Frissítés' (Refresh) button with a mock async loading state (setTimeout) that updates the 'Utolsó frissítés' timestamp.
Implement the Idea Drawer using Framer Motion (AnimatePresence) sliding in from the right edge of the screen.
The UI MUST be in Hungarian as requested (e.g., 'Összefoglaló', 'Innováció', 'Feladat', 'Beállítások').
Include a 'Programok' section visually distinguishing VIP, Mentor, Futurebet, Futurebet2.0, InnoChallenge.
Build standard filter chips for 'Feladat típus' (Innováció / Feladat / Összes).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
